topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: You ever have that feeling, like the world's trying to tell you something, but you can't quite put your finger on what it is? Well, I just found out my kid's got the same teacher I had back in the day. Old Mr. Thompson. Always wore the same patchy tweed jacket, had a way of making history feel like it happened yesterday, and a stern eye that could make a heart drop. I never thought I'd see that look again, not after all these years. Now, here I am, sitting in the same creaky chairs, the same dust-filled air, wondering just what kind of lessons he'll teach my little one. Hope it’s just history he’s sticking to, and not the rest. Guess I’ll take it one day at a time, watch my back, and keep an eye on the kids.
